title: AG2 SandboxShellTool newline injection bypasses command allowlists
summary: Embedded newlines bypass allowed-command and readonly filters while the raw argument is executed through a shell. With LocalEnvironment, commands run as host subprocesses without container isolation.

severity.rationale: Prompt-influenced shell arguments can bypass restrictions in a commonly used agent tool configuration. Host command execution warrants a 72-hour response.

affected.note: Affected through 0.14.1 inclusive. No patched autogen version is listed.

exposure: Agents using SandboxShellTool with allowed or readonly modes can execute attacker-directed commands when untrusted content influences tool arguments. The execution environment determines the resulting privileges.

params.instructions: Check for autogen 0.13.2 through 0.14.1 inclusive and restricted SandboxShellTool use. The advisory lists no fixed autogen release.

remediation.action: Update or contain the affected component
remediation.details: Upgrade ag2 to 1.1.1 or later. For affected autogen installations, stop exposing the restricted shell tool to untrusted input until a patched distribution or equivalent verified fix is available.
remediation.risk: Medium. Updating and restarting can interrupt dependent workflows.

verification: Confirm the installed version and the component used by running processes meet the documented fix or containment condition.

review.notes: Independent reviewer re-read every tier 1 source and checked every field. No open findings.

history.change: Initial record drafted from directly inspected primary sources for independent review.
